text:
Cinematic wide-angle sci-fi digital concept art, 16:9, photorealistic matte painting style. A futuristic desert city at dusk. Sky: deep indigo-navy at top with scattered tiny stars, fading through violet and magenta to glowing orange at the horizon on the right. Upper left: a huge thin crescent moon, lit on its lower-right edge, the dark disc faintly visible.

Centre-right: three slender, tapering glass skyscrapers rising from a cluster of tiered, saucer-shaped retro-futuristic buildings with teal light bands and a small low skyline of lit buildings. The central tower is tallest, teal-glass, with a glowing cyan neon halo ring floating around its spire near the top. The left tower is shorter, teal, with a vertical cyan neon sign reading "OASIS" on its left side. The right tower is shorter, lit in purple-magenta neon. Four thin teal searchlight beams shoot diagonally into the sky from behind the city.

Left midground: on a dune crest, a lone figure seen from behind in a long dark red cloak stands beside a fluffy brown alpaca on his left, both looking toward the city, silhouetted in dim light.

Foreground: sweeping orange sand dunes with fine wind ripples, sand blowing off crests, a sharp dune ridge running diagonally from lower left.

Right: an elevated monorail track with glowing amber edge-lights curving in an S-shape from the lower right toward the city, a sleek silver train on it. Beside it, a glowing turquoise oasis pool. Far right foreground: a tall saguaro cactus outlined with pink neon rim light, a small cactus behind it.

Warm amber and teal palette, atmospheric haze, dramatic lighting.
